C0294.title: Osmosis Chain Liquidity Pool Drain Vulnerability Incident
C0294.summary: A critical vulnerability was discovered in the Cosmos ecosystem DEX Osmosis, allowing anyone to add liquidity to any pool and receive an extra 50% return upon removal, potentially draining all liquidity pools. The team later confirmed the vulnerability, estimated the loss at approximately $5 million, and urgently halted on-chain activity to fix the bug.
